rounds.text: Bhagwati Autocast Ltd trades at an attractive P/E ratio of 12.9x while delivering exceptional capital returns, including an ROCE of 31.6% and an ROE of 24.7% [E1, E6, E7]. Fundamentals are significantly outpacing the share price, with a 5-year profit CAGR of 49% eclipsing a 5-year share price growth of 31% [E13, E17, E48]. This earnings strength is backed by high cash conversion of 1.31x and ₹13 Cr in free cash flow for March 2026, alongside a conservatively managed balance sheet featuring a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.15x [E28, E30, E32]. The business is also capitalizing on strong sector dynamics within Automobile & Auto Components, which enjoys a positive tailwind score of +0.53 and reports of full capacity utilization driven by rising global demand for tractors [E60, E65]. Conceded: the company has experienced poor 5-year sales growth of 10.4% and an inconsistent annual operating-margin trend over the last year [E26, E52]. Nevertheless, trailing twelve-month sales have accelerated by 25% and profit has surged by 126%, demonstrating that the core engine is operating with immense leverage [E11, E15].
